visual_check.result: title/author/front-matter and Tables IV/V visually confirmed; extraction warnings retained in rendering logs

reader_argument.observation: Bio-inspired motivation is explained to broad AI readers before specialist SNN training/pruning taxonomies; target is sparse, useful deep SNN structure, not an optimizer convergence theorem.

title_abstract.observation: Title names mechanism and model family. Abstract proceeds biological premise → dense-structure gap → neuron/channel methods with regrowth → datasets → retention/accuracy trade-off. Separate Impact Statement and Index Terms are present; their mandatory status must come from official rules, not sample frequency.

introduction.observation: Builds practical computational/embedded-device motivation and ends with three contribution bullets: sparse method, quantitative memory/energy analysis, experiments. Recurring biological premise is a candidate for compression, not a venue requirement.

related_work.observation: Early standalone related work divided into Model training, Pruning method, Motivation; ANN vs SNN and unstructured vs structured pruning distinctions justify design choices. No universal TAI section-order claim.

method_theory.observation: Main text gives IF charge/fire/reset equations, surrogate function, pruning masks, BN/tdBN, sparsity loss, and two algorithms. Neuron variant prunes/regrows during training; channel variant pretrains with sparsity penalty, prunes, then fine-tunes. These distinct stage maps must survive polishing. No independent convergence theorem is claimed.

evidence.observation: Results sections separate settings, pruning granularity, noise, parameter/operation analysis, comparison. Tables expose baseline, retained/pruned configuration, accuracy, fine-tuned accuracy and resources; comparison table explicitly lists architecture/training/time steps/connectivity, enabling fairness bounds. Noise is specified Gaussian test corruptions, not a general robustness theorem.

discussion_limits.observation: No dedicated limitations section. Trade-offs are discussed near result comparisons: sparsity may be less than competing models although time steps lower. Conclusion returns biological motivation and deployment potential. Existing tested bounds belong in conclusions; no silent new hardware-deployment claim.

paragraph_language.observation: Numbered technical subsections and bold run-in labels aid scanning; explanatory prose is repeated and occasionally grammatically imprecise. Publication is not evidence that repeated generic claims or unqualified significantly are suitable style norms.

main_appendix.observation: All equations, algorithm specifications and empirical tables are in nine-page accepted manuscript; references finish paper 9. No appendix/supplement reference or code link appears in actual full text; institution lists one manuscript asset. No separately referenced prose appendix was identified. Institutional cover is source provenance, not journal-format text.

actionable.observation: For an empirical sparse-model paper, maintain Abstract/Impact/Index Terms as required by official configuration, use a stage-specific method map, expose resource-performance trade-offs and comparison differences, and distinguish estimated energy from measured deployment. Transfer only under the same article type, not all TAI topics.

counterexamples.finding: Abstract about 10% retained parameters with <1% loss is supported by CIFAR10 channel retention 11.13% and 0.60 percentage-point loss. Table V CIFAR100 at 13.06% retained loses 10.06 points. Do not generalize the headline to every dataset/variant or silently treat percentage-point differences as relative percent.
counterexamples.action: Scope the summary to dataset, architecture, variant and fine-tuning stage.

counterexamples.pages: paper 7 Table IV and paragraph D; PDF 8
counterexamples.finding: Energy numbers derive from synaptic operations and a cited TrueNorth 26 pJ assumption; no documented hardware energy-measurement procedure or actual chip deployment. Large parameter reduction coexists with synaptic-operation counts near 28K across pruned channel settings.
counterexamples.action: Name proxy/assumption and separate parameter-memory reductions from energy/latency evidence; do not rewrite as measured deployment.

counterexamples.pages: paper 7 paragraph E vs Table V paper 8; PDF 8–9
counterexamples.finding: Prose describes 4.82 times the original; Table V connectivity is 4.82%, and Table IV 0.71M/14.72M = 4.82%. This is a unit conflict in the source, not a linguistic norm.
counterexamples.action: Flag author clarification; do not preserve misleading multiplier or fabricate replacement experimental values.

counterexamples.finding: Broad from-scratch wording and pretrained wording are reconciled only by separating neuron dynamic training from channel sparse-pretrain/prune/fine-tune stages.
counterexamples.action: Use variant/stage-specific descriptions rather than one uniform chronological claim.

counterexamples.finding: Competing entries differ in architectures, training methods, time steps and connectivity. Some competitors have higher absolute accuracy or greater sparsity.
counterexamples.action: Do not write universally superior at matched conditions; state observed trade-off and actual comparison settings.

counterexamples.finding: Introduction says significantly, while inspected experimental text/tables do not report repeated-seed count, variance or significance testing.
counterexamples.action: Avoid adding statistical-significance claims solely because the accepted paper uses that adjective.

derived_rules.rule: Separate biological motivation, algorithm implementation and empirically observed resource/accuracy trade-offs.
